title: Core: AS2 Color class and ColorTransform built-ins
description: Test compilation of Color class: var c = new Color(mc), c.setRGB(0xFF0000), c.getRGB(), c.setTransform(obj), c.getTransform(). Test ColorTransform usage pattern (Flash 8 vs AS3). Verify ActionNew (0x4a) for construction, ActionCallMethod (0x52) for method calls, ActionGetMember (0x4f) for property access.
